caption: The drawing is on a beige or off-white paper and is enclosed within a rectangular border. In the upper left, inside a faint yellow-orange wash, are the words "FRANK B NORTON WORCESTER MASS" rendered in block capitals. Below the text and to the left center of the composition is an abstract, swirling design of curved lines and petal-like shapes in shades of blue and purple, accented with small tear-drop forms above the swirl. The design is dynamic, featuring thick, looping lines that interlace and gather towards the center. To the lower right, there is a simple line drawing of a pitcher or jug, facing right, with the same blue and purple swirling design depicted on its side. At the very bottom left edge, the name "Geo. Loughridge" is written in small block letters. The drawing uses mainly blue, purple, brown, and yellow-orange colors.
title: Pitcher
